description: The JEGS Brass 90 Deg Fitting provides a reliable connection solution for fuel and hydraulic systems requiring transition between 3/8 in. NPT and 5/8 in. -18 inverted flare connections. Constructed from solid brass, this fitting resists corrosion and maintains structural integrity under high-pressure applications common in performance fuel systems. The 90-degree angle design maximizes space efficiency in tight engine compartment layouts while the precision-machined threads ensure secure, leak-free connections that are critical for safe fuel delivery. This fitting's robust construction and proven design make it an essential component for any fuel system upgrade or restoration project where reliable pressure-rated connections are non-negotiable.
features: Solid Brass Construction — Resists corrosion and oxidation for long-term reliability in fuel and hydraulic applications, eliminating the need for frequent replacement.
3/8 in. NPT to 5/8 in. -18 Inverted Flare Connection — Provides precise compatibility with standard fuel system components, ensuring proper fit and eliminating adapter chains.
90-Degree Angle Design — Fits into tight engine compartment spaces and routes fuel lines efficiently without sharp bends that could restrict flow or cause kinks.
High-Pressure Rated — Engineered to handle demanding fuel system pressures without leaking or failing, critical for carburetor and fuel injection systems.
Precision-Machined Threads — Delivers consistent, secure connections that prevent fuel weeping and maintain system integrity during operation and storage.

description: The JEGS Oval Paper Filter Element maximizes engine protection through a high-flow design that delivers superior air intake while effectively trapping contaminants and particulates. Measuring 14.5 in. long by 8 in. wide by 2 in. tall, this white paper filter element is engineered specifically for oval filter housings, providing the expanded surface area necessary for improved filtration efficiency compared to standard round elements. The high-flow paper media allows more air to reach the engine while capturing dust, dirt, and debris before they cause wear on pistons, cylinders, and valve components. Whether you're upgrading to a performance air intake system or maintaining your vehicle's existing filtration setup, this element ensures consistent airflow and engine cleanliness for optimal power and longevity.
features: High-Flow Paper Media — Maximizes air intake volume while trapping particulates, delivering better engine breathing and improved throttle response compared to restrictive filters.
14.5 in. L x 8 in. W x 2 in. H Dimensions — Specifically engineered for oval filter housings, eliminating fitment issues and ensuring proper seal against bypass.
Expanded Surface Area — Provides greater filtration capacity and longer service intervals by distributing airflow across more media, reducing pressure drop and engine strain.
White Paper Construction — Delivers superior filtration efficiency against dust and contaminants without sacrificing airflow, protecting critical engine components from premature wear.
OEM-Compatible Design — Drops directly into factory and aftermarket oval filter housings, maintaining compatibility with existing intake systems without modification.

description: The JEGS Fuel Line delivers fuel from the pump to the carburetor with authentic OEM-style fitment and proven reliability for 1963-1966 Chevrolet models equipped with 194, 230, or 250 cubic inch six-cylinder engines. Constructed from original material steel, this line is engineered with correct routing and connection points to fit Bel Air, Biscayne, Impala, Chevelle, El Camino, and Malibu vehicles, ensuring optimal fuel delivery without leaks or restrictions. The precision-formed design eliminates guesswork during installation, as each bend and fitting point matches the factory layout, allowing fuel to flow efficiently from the pump to the carburetor under all operating conditions. Restorers and performance enthusiasts alike rely on this line to maintain authentic underhood appearance while guaranteeing leak-free fuel system operation.
features: OEM-Style Steel Construction — Manufactured from original material specification steel, ensuring durability and corrosion resistance that matches factory fuel line standards.
Universal Fit for 194, 230, 250 cu. in. Six-Cylinder Engines — Accommodates all common Chevrolet six-cylinder displacements from this era, maximizing compatibility across multiple models.
Authentic Routing and Fitment — Pre-formed to match factory routing through engine compartment, eliminating the need for custom bending and ensuring professional appearance.
Fits Bel Air, Biscayne, Impala, Chevelle, El Camino, Malibu — Covers the full range of 1963-1966 Chevrolet model lines, making it the ideal choice for multi-model collections.
Leak-Free Fuel Delivery — Precision connections and proper sizing eliminate seeping and fuel system pressure loss, ensuring carburetor flooding and engine starting reliability.

Whether you're returning a project car to original specifications or upgrading a neglected daily driver, this mirror restores the distinctive GM look while providing dependable service.
features: Authentic Chevy Bowtie Logo — Features genuine Chevrolet branding that restores original identity and authenticity to any 1966-1974 GM restoration project.
Chrome Finish — Provides a polished, show-quality appearance that resists tarnishing and complements original paint and trim while requiring minimal maintenance.
Left or Right Side Mounting — Universal fitment options eliminate the need to source separate left and right mirrors, reducing inventory complexity and cost.
Complete Installation Hardware — Includes mounting bracket, gasket, and fasteners, allowing straightforward bolt-on installation without hunting for hard-to-find period-correct parts.
Manual Adjustment Capability — Delivers simple, reliable mirror angle adjustment without complex mechanisms, matching the original driver experience and reducing potential failure points.

description: The JEGS Heavy Duty Swivel Shop Stool combines comfort and durability for extended work sessions, featuring a 330 lb. weight capacity and full 360-degree swivel for effortless movement around your workspace. description: The JEGS Extended Reach Air Cut-Off Tool delivers precision cutting power in a compact 14.5-inch package specifically designed for accessing tight spaces and confined work areas where full-size grinders cannot fit. Operating at 13,000 RPM with the included 4-inch cut-off wheel, this reversible pneumatic tool handles a wide range of cutting applications from metal fabrication to brake line work. The low-profile, reversible head design allows technicians to orient the tool for optimal control and visibility regardless of work angle. Powered by compressed air, this tool requires no battery charging and provides consistent power output throughout the job. The compact footprint and high RPM rating make this air cut-off tool indispensable for detailed fabrication work and tight-access repairs.
features: 13,000 RPM cutting speed with 4-inch wheel enables fast, clean cuts through metal materials while maintaining precision in detailed fabrication tasks.

description: The JEGS OE-Style Mini Starter delivers reliable, powerful engine cranking for small block and big block Chevrolet engines with its 168-tooth ring gear engagement and proven mechanical design. Featuring a 5:1 gear reduction and robust 1.8 horsepower output, this starter handles compression ratios up to 10.0:1, making it suitable for stock, modified, and high-compression performance builds. At only 8 pounds, the lightweight construction minimizes parasitic drag on the engine, helping preserve horsepower and fuel efficiency compared to heavier OEM starters. The 168-tooth staggered design ensures reliable engagement without stripping or slipping, critical for repeated high-RPM starts during racing or street driving. This compact, efficient starter integrates seamlessly into existing engine bays while providing the dependable cranking force serious Chevy engines demand.
features: 168-tooth staggered ring gear engagement prevents stripping and ensures positive starter-to-flywheel contact during every cold start and repeated high-RPM cranking cycles.
5:1 gear reduction combined with 1.8 HP output spins the engine efficiently even at high compression ratios up to 10.0:1, essential for performance builds.
Only 8-pound weight eliminates parasitic drag on the engine, preserving horsepower and improving fuel economy compared to heavier traditional starters.
Compact OE-style design fits into existing Chevy small block and big block engine bays without requiring custom brackets or intake modifications.
Proven mechanical reliability with no electronic components or solenoid complications, delivering consistent starting performance in race, street, and marine applications.

description: The JEGS Universal Electric Marine Fuel Pump delivers reliable fuel delivery at 72 gallons per hour with a modest 6-8 psi output ideal for carbureted marinized engines and classic powerboat applications. Operating on a 12-volt DC system with only 1 amp draw, this pump runs efficiently without straining boat electrical systems, batteries, or wiring—a critical advantage in marine environments where electrical capacity is often limited. The self-priming capability allows the pump to establish fuel flow without requiring manual priming or gravity-feed tanks, reducing startup time and eliminating air locks in fuel lines. Universal mounting and inlet/outlet sizing make this pump compatible with various small block engines, fuel tanks, and carbureted fuel systems found in classic and restored boats. This pump's dependable performance and low power consumption make it an excellent choice for marinized V8 engines requiring consistent, pressure-regulated fuel delivery in marine applications.
features: 72 GPH fuel delivery capacity provides adequate flow for small block engines running carburetors, ensuring crisp throttle response and consistent performance across all RPM ranges.
6-8 psi pressure output specifically calibrated for carburetor fuel systems prevents fuel flooding while maintaining adequate supply pressure for reliable atomization.
Self-priming design eliminates the need for manual priming or gravity-feed setups, reducing startup time and preventing air locks that compromise fuel delivery reliability.
1 amp draw at 12V DC operates on minimal electrical current, preventing battery drain and excessive wiring load in marine electrical systems with limited capacity.
Universal mounting and hose connections adapt to most fuel tank locations and carburetor inlet configurations, simplifying installation in marinized small block retrofit projects.
